default.rationale: Default for engine and GUI work.

signals: concurrency, crash recovery, or atomic persistence
tiers.rationale: Failure can corrupt state, leak data, or silently violate a hard invariant.
Cross-cutting engine work needs deep integration reasoning and adversarial tests.
Strong default for production engine and GUI changes.
A smaller model is sufficient for bounded data plumbing with validation.

constraints.effort: Recommend an effort only when the selected backend advertises effort_control; otherwise set effort to null.
constraints.cost: Use integer micro-USD math from a verified price only and label the display estimate with ≈. Unknown or unpriced models must display unmetered, never $0.00.
constraints.haiku: Not recommended for this repository because the large single-file engine requires deep context.
constraints.execution: The advisor never runs or rewrites the input. Running requires a separate explicit action and must use the original input unchanged.
